    Network Operations Engineer

    1. About the role

    Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

    For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

    We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

    The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

    You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

    2. What you'll do

    Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

    Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

    Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

    Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

    Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

    Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

    Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

    3. Who we're looking for

    A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

    Must-have

    • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

    • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

    • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

    • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

    • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

    • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

    • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

    • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

    • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

    Nice-to-have

    • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

    • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

    • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

    • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

    • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

    • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

    • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

    • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

    • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

    4. What we offer

    • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

    • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

    • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

    • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

    Our Mission

    At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

    We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

    THE ROLE

    As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

    You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

    WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

    • Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites.

    • Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather.

    • Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse.

    • Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them.

    • Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors.

    • Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control.

    • Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts.

    • New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design.

    • The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack.

    • Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions.

    WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

    We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments.

    YOUR BACKGROUND:

    • A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

    • Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth).

    • Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors.

    • Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior.

    • Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions.

    • Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries.

    • Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests.

    • Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills.

    • Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs.

    • Willingness to visit customer sites regularly.

    • Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation.

    • Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation.

    • Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog.

    • Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments.

    Our Mission

    At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to.     We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

    THE ROLE

    As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will build and own the state estimation that tells our robots how they are moving and where they are. You'll fuse data from IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, and platform-specific odometry into accurate, real-time estimates that support reliable autonomy day and night, across different robot platforms.

    This is a builder's role first: you'll use the estimation methods and tools best suited to the problem, then do the engineering needed to make them work on real robots. Our robots operate in complex environments where terrain, weather, vibration, lighting, and sensor dropouts degrade measurements. We care less about novelty for its own sake and more about whether your systems perform reliably across platforms in the field.

    WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

    • Design and ship real-time estimators for position, orientation, velocity, and angular velocity across our robot platforms.

    • Fuse data from multiple sensors, handling noise, asynchronous measurements, calibration errors, changing sensor quality, and dropouts.

You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.</p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product</li> <li>Act as the programme’s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.</p> <p>You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build/buy/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)</li> <li>Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:<br></strong></p> <p>You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.</p> <p><strong> What We Offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world</li> <li>A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence</li> <li>Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career</li> <li>Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track</li> <li>A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies</li> <li>A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts</li> <li>A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.     About the role

    Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities.

    At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority.     What You´ll Do

    • Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs.
    • Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes.
    • Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring.
    • Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring
    • Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards).
    • Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes.
    • Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions.
    • Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met.

    Requirements

    What You’ll Need

    • 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry
    • Experience with supplier quality management.
    • Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken.
    • Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required.
    • Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs).
    • Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills

    Who You Are

    You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.

Sie arbeiten in einem hochwertigen Umfeld, in dem Qualität nicht nur bei der Behandlung zählt, sondern auch in jedem Kontakt mit unseren Gästen.

Aufgaben

  • Führen Sie klassische und wellnessorientierte Massageanwendungen professionell und mit einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste durch.

  • Beraten Sie unsere Gäste individuell zu passenden Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen und finden Sie gemeinsam mit ihnen die Behandlung, die zu ihren persönlichen Bedürfnissen passt.

  • Betreuen Sie unsere Gäste während ihres gesamten Aufenthalts im Deimann Spa aufmerksam, herzlich und professionell.
  • Bereiten Sie die Behandlungsräume sorgfältig vor und nach, damit jede Anwendung in einer ruhigen, gepflegten und hochwertigen Atmosphäre stattfinden kann.
  • Sichern Sie durch Ihre sorgfältige Arbeitsweise die hohen Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards unseres Spa-Bereichs.
  • Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Spa-Team zusammen und tragen Sie dazu bei, dass unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und persönlich aufmerksam betreut werden.
  • Gestalten Sie mit Ihrer Arbeit ein Spa-Erlebnis, das unseren Gästen Ruhe, Entspannung und die besondere Qualität des Hotel Deimann vermittelt.
  • Arbeiten Sie überwiegend tagsüber bis in die Abendstunden, regulär bis etwa 19:00 Uhr. Auch Sonn- und Feiertage gehören zu Ihrem Arbeitsalltag.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Masseur/in, Physiotherapeut/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, damit Sie unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und verantwortungsvoll behandeln können.
  • Sie bringen idealerweise praktische Erfahrung in Massage, Physiotherapie, Wellness oder einem Spa mit – aber auch als Berufseinsteiger/in sind Sie willkommen, wenn Ihre fachliche Qualifikation und Ihre Haltung zu uns passen.
  • Sie verfügen über fachliche Kompetenz und arbeiten sorgfältig, weil hochwertige Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Präzision erfordern.
  • Sie haben Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Menschen, weil eine gute Spa-Behandlung nicht nur von der richtigen Technik, sondern ebenso von Aufmerksamkeit und Einfühlungsvermögen lebt.
  • Sie arbeiten serviceorientiert und aufmerksam, damit sich unsere Gäste während ihrer gesamten Behandlung persönlich wahrgenommen und bestens aufgehoben fühlen.
  • Sie treten gepflegt und professionell auf, weil Ihr persönliches Auftreten wesentlich zur hochwertigen Atmosphäre im Deimann Spa beiträgt.
  • Sie arbeiten selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst, damit sich unsere Gäste jederzeit auf Ihre fachliche und persönliche Betreuung verlassen können.
  • Sie sind ein Teamplayer und unterstützen Ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen, weil ein außergewöhnliches Spa-Erlebnis nur gemeinsam entstehen kann.
  • Sie bringen Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Sonn- und Feiertagen mit, da unser Spa auch an diesen Tagen für unsere Gäste geöffnet ist.
  • Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse, damit Sie unsere Gäste sicher, aufmerksam und persönlich beraten und betreuen können.

🍽️ Essen inklusive: Kostenfreie Verpflegung während der Arbeit

🏡 Gut ankommen im Sauerland: Während der Probezeit können Sie bei Bedarf für weniger als 500 € monatlich bei uns wohnen – inklusive WLAN, Strom, Gas und Wasser.

🔑 Ihr Zuhause auf Dauer: Wenn Sie langfristig eine eigene Wohnung suchen, unterstützen wir Sie gerne bei der Wohnungssuche.

💪 Fitness & Entspannung: Nutzen Sie unser Fitnessstudio täglich und unseren Spa-Bereich montags und freitags von 18 bis 22 Uhr – für Bewegung, Erholung und Zeit für sich.

❤️ Gesundheit im Blick: Mit voiio erhalten Sie Zugang zu Angeboten und Unterstützung rund um Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und persönliche Lebensbereiche.

🌱 Entwicklung, die zu Ihnen passt: Interne und externe Schulungen sowie persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten helfen Ihnen dabei, Ihre Stärken weiter auszubauen.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

At MEDvidi, the Marketing team helps connect patients with mental healthcare through paid and organic acquisition. Working within our cross-functional Demand and Supply group, the team focuses on growing demand efficiently and aligning acquisition with our capacity to deliver care.

We're hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to help scale acquisition while maintaining a strong return on marketing spend and effort. You'll analyze channel performance, identify opportunities for investment, investigate conversion funnel issues, and turn data into recommendations the team can act on.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze the performance of paid and organic marketing channels and individual campaigns.
  • Recommend how to allocate paid marketing spend across channels and campaigns.
  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor acquisition performance and conversion funnels.
  • Investigate funnel drop-offs and identify opportunities to improve acquisition and conversion.
  • Investigate issues and discrepancies in marketing data to improve reporting accuracy and reliability.
  • Monitor marketing attribution and help resolve measurement gaps and issues.
  • Plan, launch, monitor, and analyze A/B and A/B/n experiments in collaboration with the team.
  • Serve as a data-driven advisor to our cross-functional Demand and Supply group, communicating findings and recommendations clearly.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience as a Marketing Data Analyst.
  • Experience in marketing analytics within B2C HealthTech, telemedicine, subscription-based digital products, or e-commerce.
  • Recent hands-on experience in web marketing analytics, with a focus on paid acquisition, website conversion funnels, attribution, and marketing ROI. Experience limited to mobile or desktop applications does not meet this requirement.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance in US, European, or other international markets, with an understanding of how market differences affect acquisition performance, user behavior, and conversion funnels.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL; experience using Python for data analysis.
  • Experience with event-based web analytics tools such as PostHog, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with BI tools and building dashboards. We use Tableau, but experience with other systems is welcome.
  • Solid knowledge of statistics and probability, with the ability to apply them to business questions and experiments.
  • A structured approach to problem-solving: clarify the question, define the analytical plan, and then carry out the work.
  • Ownership and follow-through, with the ability to prioritize work based on business impact.
  • Transparent communication and an evidence-based approach to decision-making.
  • Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher.
  • Proficiency in using LLMs in daily work, with the ability to critically evaluate their output.
  • Ability to work CET/CEST overlapping hours.
  • Comfortable working under a long-term B2B contractor model using personal equipment.

﻿Would be a plus

  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager.
  • Basic understanding of web technologies.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 3 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

GPG Mfg Unit Manager

Business Line Sales & Operations Planning Leader will be responsible for driving our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process to the next level and for connecting it with the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) process.

The Business Line Sales & Operations Planning Leader supports the connection between Demand Planning, Supply Planning processes and Global Capacity enhancement with the goal of improving the organization's ability to fulfill global customer demand. In addition to the creation and facilitation of the monthly supply planning drumbeat, the task is to engage stakeholders and provide a process design ready to use and deploy for supply planning and reconciliation. A strong implementation focus, change management and a clear definition of process responsibilities are key to success.


This position will report to Business Line Global Manufacturing.


Your responsibilities


  • Lead and coordinate unit-specific and cross-unit projects aimed at improving planning and fulfillment metrics such as On-Time Delivery, Inventory Turns, Lead Time and Plan Accuracy.
  • Design and implement the S&OP process from an operations perspective (supply planning and reconciliation).
  • Stakeholder management and definition of roles and responsibilities within the S&OP process.
  • Governance of the monthly Global Business Supply Planning drumbeat and related KPIs and reporting.
  • Focus on the further development of the S&OE process. Connect the S&OE and S&OP processes.
  • Facilitate the Supply Planning drumbeat, related reviews and approvals to improve demand-supply balance.
  • Identify and propose projects to drive the internal planning process to the next level using SAP MM, SAP PP, and an advanced planning tool.
  • Perform standard and ad hoc analyses related to S&OP and S&OE metrics such as Plan Accuracy and On-Time Delivery, including identifying key root causes for non-performance and driving related improvement initiatives.
  • Act as a "subject matter expert" for S&OP and S&OE, establish and share best practices, conduct cross-unit process assessments and benchmarking.
  • Build competencies within the organization by training and coaching the Planning & Fulfillment community.
  • Facilitate fit-gap analyses of IBP-related IS tools, assist with the deployment of standard IS solutions for Planning & Fulfillment and provide professional support for users.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 8+ years of experience in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), demand planning, supply planning, production planning, or integrated business planning within a manufacturing environment.
  • Advanced experience with Anaplan and other advanced forecasting/planning platforms and tools (SAP APO or others).
  • Proven experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites and balancing demand across a global manufacturing footprint.
  • Proven track record of improving Planning & Fulfillment, especially in the area of Sales & Operations Planning implementation and improvement.
  • Strong expertise in the Planning & Fulfillment domains of Planning and Disposition, Sales & Operations Planning and Execution.
  • Key skills and execution experience in Supply Planning.
  • Advanced knowledge of SAP (MM, PP, and WM modules).
  • Experience in the application of Project Management and Lean/Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Strong leadership capabilities across team boundaries and with limited formal authority.
  • Customer-focused and action-oriented, with a systematic and structured approach.
  • Cultural awareness and the ability to work within a global organization.
  • Strong communication skills in English, along with solid consulting and facilitation skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master's degree preferred and 10+ years of S&OP, Integrated Business Planning (IBP), or Global Supply Chain Planning experience.
  • Experience leading S&OP processes across a global manufacturing network.
  • Experience supporting facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia.

The Area Service Manager – Los Angeles & Rockies is responsible for leading a team of Field Service Engineers and delivering sage, high-quality performance across the assigned territory. This role translates zone priorities into consistent field execution by coaching and developing associates, managing customer and operational priorities, ensuring effective workforce deployment, and driving continuous improvement through the Danaher Business System (DBS). This role serves as a clear advocate for the customer and the business, translating zone service strategy into field execution while reinforcing accountability, customer focus, and sustainable operating behaviors.


This position reports to the Zone Service Manager – Western US and is part of the Equipment Services organization, working remotely in the Los Angeles, CA area to cover the Los Angeles & Rockies service area.


What you will do:

  • Own area-level service business performance, including revenue growth contribution, operational effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and consistent execution across the Los Angeles & Rockies service area.
  • Lead execution of service growth mechanisms within the area, including service contract capture, unit adds, renewals, and digital or service attachment, ensuring field service engineers are enabled, accountable, and capable of identifying customer needs and directly proposing service offerings in partnership with Service Sales, Product Management, and Commercial teams.

  • Deploy and sustain DBS operating rigor, including ownership of Daily Management cadence, Visual Management, Problem Solving Process (PSP), standard work, and Kaizen execution across the area to ensure accountability, follow-through, and sustained performance improvement.
  • Ensure operational excellence and service delivery performance, including high-quality execution of new equipment installations and critical service events, driving improvement in key service KPIs such as applied time, utilization, first-time fix, PM completion, response time, quality, and safety.
  • Serve as the primary management escalation point for complex and high-pressure customer, operational, or performance issues, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues quickly while protecting customer relationships and the long-term interests of the business.
  • Partner cross-functionally with the Zone Service Manager and commercial, product, and operations leaders to align field execution, capacity planning, and customer priorities with zone and business objectives.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional/military experience.
  • Significant experience leading customer-facing field service organizations within life sciences, biotechnology, medical devices, or other high-technology environments.
  • Previous managerial experience, including responsibility for developing and leading Field Service Engineers or other customer-facing technical associates.
  • Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed and remote service teams across complex territories.
  • Demonstrated use of Danaher Business System (DBS) tools, including Daily Management, standard work, problem solving, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Proven experience managing or influencing service revenue, growth initiatives, and operational performance metrics at an area or territory level, including contract growth, renewals, and profitability contribution.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel approximately up to 30%, including overnight travel, primarily within the Los Angeles & Rockies service area, and occasionally to the Northeast.

Marketing Analyst - A/E/C Marketing & Proposals
Location: Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate (must reside in the U.S.). Otherwise, hybrid office locations include: Hebron, KY / Cincinnati, OH; Nashville, TN; Indianapolis, IN.
Salary Range: $60,000–$70,000, depending on experience. Bonus Opportunities.

Company Overview
Would you enjoy helping a growing national consultancy tell its story, pursue new opportunities, and strengthen how it connects with clients?

Connico is a national construction consultancy known for its experienced team and commitment to exceptional client service. With deep experience in aviation and complex infrastructure, we are continuing to expand our work across energy, federal, and defense markets.

Our marketing function plays an important role in positioning Connico for new work by developing strong proposals, communicating our technical expertise, and supporting business development efforts across our markets.

Our work is technical, but how we do the work matters just as much as the quality of what we deliver. Our core values of Respect, Integrity, Innovation, Resiliency, Inclusivity, and Thoughtfulness guide how we work with our clients and with one another.

The Role
Connico is seeking an experienced A/E/C marketing professional to join our Business Development/Marketing team as a Marketing Analyst.

This is a growth-oriented position for someone who already understands A/E/C proposals and marketing and is ready to take on increasing responsibility. You will work closely with our Senior Marketing Specialist, technical professionals, and leadership to develop proposals and marketing content, maintain project and pursuit information, research opportunities, and support broader marketing and business development activities.

The role is designed to grow in scope and independence over time, with a career path to Marketing Specialist and Senior Marketing Specialist.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop proposals, qualifications packages, and other pursuit materials using established processes, templates, and standards.
  • Identify and assemble project experience, staff qualifications, resumes, technical information, approach content, graphics, and other materials needed for pursuits.
  • Write, edit, format, and organize content that clearly communicates Connico’s qualifications, experience, differentiators, and value to clients.
  • Review solicitation requirements and coordinate proposal activities with technical staff and other contributors.
  • Research upcoming projects, clients, procurement activity, and potential teaming opportunities.
  • Complete and coordinate prequalification packages, vendor registrations, teaming documentation, MBE/SBE information, and related pursuit requirements.
  • Maintain accurate client, project, pursuit, and marketing information within A/E/C CRM, project database, and marketing information systems.
  • Research and organize project information for proposals, marketing activities, project closeouts, and business development reporting.
  • Translate technical project information into compelling client-focused stories and marketing content.
  • Support development of project profiles, one-sheets, case studies, presentations, brochures, articles, award submissions, and other marketing collateral.
  • Assist with website content, social media content, and coordination with public relations, website, and other outside marketing partners.
  • Support client interviews, presentations, conferences, events, and other business development and brand-building activities.
  • Manage multiple proposals, prequalifications, marketing projects, and deadlines while communicating proactively with team members.
  • Build progressively greater knowledge of Connico’s projects, clients, markets, services, systems, and differentiators and take on greater ownership as your experience with Connico grows.
What We’re Looking For
  • Approximately 3–5 years of progressive marketing, proposal, or communications experience within the A/E/C industry.
  • Direct experience developing A/E/C proposals, qualifications packages, marketing collateral, or similar client-facing pursuit materials.
  • Strong ability to turn complex or technical information into clear, persuasive written and visual content.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, with working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, or related Adobe applications.
  • Experience working with A/E/C-specific CRM, project database, or marketing information systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, layout, research, and visual communication skills.
  • Experience locating, organizing, evaluating, and validating information from multiple sources.
  • Ability to successfully manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Preferred Experience
  • A/E/C and Federal marketing, proposal, or procurement experience.
  • Experience with public-sector procurement, prequalifications, qualifications-based selection processes, or similar pursuit requirements.
  • Experience with website content management systems and professional social media platforms.

Growth Opportunity
This position is intended for an experienced A/E/C marketer who wants to continue developing professionally rather than remain in a narrowly defined coordinator role. The Marketing Analyst will initially work closely with the Senior Marketing Specialist and will have the opportunity to build greater independence and judgment across proposals, pursuits, marketing content, project information systems, digital content, and broader marketing operations.

The career path for this position is Marketing Analyst → Marketing Specialist → Senior Marketing Specialist.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role?

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Enjoy turning technical information into clear, compelling content for clients and pursuit teams.
  • Can manage multiple proposals, deadlines, and competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Are comfortable researching project information, asking the right questions, and working across technical teams to find what you need.
  • Take ownership of assigned work while recognizing when additional review, input, or strategic guidance is needed.
  • Enjoy both the creative and organizational sides of A/E/C marketing, including proposals, content development, project information, and pursuit support.
  • Are motivated to deepen your knowledge, expand your responsibilities, and grow into a more independent marketing role over time.
Compensation
The anticipated salary range for this position is $60,000–$70,000 annually, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Candidates are not expected to arrive knowing Connico’s projects, clients, systems, or internal processes. The strongest candidates will bring the A/E/C marketing, proposal, Adobe Creative Cloud, and CRM/database foundation needed to contribute quickly, along with the aptitude and interest to develop broader responsibility and professional judgment over time.

Work Location Options
Hybrid:
  • Hebron, KY (Cincinnati area)
  • Mt. Juliet, TN (Nashville area)
Fully Remote:
  • Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate.
  • Must reside full-time in the U.S.

Why Join Connico?
This is an opportunity to build on your A/E/C marketing experience while developing broader responsibility across proposals, pursuits, marketing content, project information, digital communications, and business development support.

You will work closely with an experienced Senior Marketing Specialist and with technical professionals across Connico, giving you the opportunity to learn the company’s projects, markets, clients, and approach while progressively taking greater ownership of the work.

This position is intentionally designed for growth. As your knowledge, judgment, and capabilities develop, you can progress from Marketing Analyst to Marketing Specialist and Senior Marketing Specialist.

We value people who take ownership, ask good questions, communicate clearly, care about the quality of their work, and continue looking for ways to improve. If you have a strong A/E/C marketing foundation and want a role where you can contribute now while continuing to grow, we would like to hear from you!

NMI is looking for a Senior Product Owner to drive tactical delivery across our Billing and Data platform teams. This role sits within the Engineering organization, reporting directly to the Director of Software Engineering, and carries ownership across two interconnected domains: Billing, which manages five distinct billing platforms, and Data, which owns ingestion and transformation pipelines built on GCP and BigQuery.

As a Senior PO at NMI, you are the subject matter expert for every feature your team builds. You do not hand off context to others — you carry it. You are present in the details: writing sharp user stories, validating acceptance criteria, conducting UAT, and ensuring releases meet the bar. You are the go-to person for your engineering team, your product manager, and your stakeholders when questions arise about how the platforms work, what is in flight, and what is coming next.

The seniority of this role comes through in the depth of your platform knowledge, your ability to navigate complexity across two technical domains simultaneously, and your capacity to influence decisions at the architecture and cross-team level — while never losing sight of day-to-day delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Agile Execution

  • Lead delivery for the Billing and Data teams by managing team backlogs, facilitating Agile ceremonies, and ensuring work is clearly defined, prioritized, and ready for engineering execution.
  • Author detailed feature epics and user stories with precise acceptance criteria that give engineering teams the clarity needed to deliver without ambiguity.
  • Conduct and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that releases meet functional requirements, quality standards, and platform integrity expectations — including writing and executing SQL queries directly against BigQuery to verify data accuracy and pipeline correctness.
  • Coordinate release planning, write detailed release notes, and manage internal rollout communications for both platforms.
  • Collaborate with peer Product Owners to manage cross-team dependencies and sequencing across shared initiatives.
  • Partner with Product Managers to deeply understand product strategy and vision, ensuring tactical execution is consistently aligned with business direction and stakeholder priorities.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to align on resource capacity and incorporate technical guidance into backlog planning, sequencing, and delivery decisions.
  • Collaborate with the Program Manager to support cross-functional coordination, ensuring key features are delivered with the right stakeholder alignment and organizational visibility.
  • Define and validate Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) that incrementally deliver value while aligning with NMI's strategic goals.
  • Provide product training and enablement for customer-facing teams, support, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain transparency by communicating upcoming work, progress, and timelines to stakeholders and executives.

    Billing Platform Expertise

    • Develop and sustain deep knowledge of NMI's five billing platforms: their architectures, business rules, interdependencies, and how they serve different merchant and partner segments.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for billing-related feature questions across engineering, finance, and operations stakeholders.
    • Partner with finance and cross-functional teams to ensure billing operations are compliant, auditable, and accurately integrated across key systems (e.g., payment processors, CRMs, ERP systems).
    • Translate complex billing requirements from cross-functional stakeholders into well-defined, executable user stories.
    • Identify and flag platform-level risks, technical debt, and consolidation opportunities in partnership with engineering leadership.

    Data Platform Expertise

    • Develop and sustain deep knowledge of the Data team's ingestion pipelines, transformation layers, and data artifact delivery on GCP and BigQuery.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for data platform questions, pipeline scope, and data artifact requirements across analytics and reporting stakeholders.
    • Author and execute SQL queries against BigQuery as a core part of UAT — validating pipeline outputs, confirming transformation accuracy, and ensuring data meets acceptance criteria before releases go live.
    • Partner with data engineering to define and prioritize data models, views, and dashboards that meet stakeholder reporting needs.
    • Advocate for data governance, lineage, and best practices in scalability, usability, and privacy-compliant data handling.

    Qualifications

    • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager, with a track record of deep feature ownership in platform, infrastructure, or data-centric environments.
    • Proven ability to become the go-to SME for the products and features you own — including technical depth, not just business context.
    • Strong understanding of cloud-based data platforms, pipelines, and tools (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, etc.).
    • Ability to write and execute SQL queries against BigQuery as part of UAT validation — confirming pipeline outputs, transformation logic, and data accuracy meet acceptance criteria.
    • Skilled in Agile development frameworks and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Figma).
    • Experience conducting and managing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure product quality and stakeholder satisfaction.
    • Effective communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Experience coordinating software release cycles, QA processes, and documentation.
    • Passion for understanding end users and translating insights into actionable product enhancements.

    Nice to Have

    • Experience with financial systems, billing platforms, or accounting modules in a SaaS or fintech environment.
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform preferred).
    • Experience in data governance or privacy-compliant data handling (GDPR, CCPA).
    • Technical background (CS degree or equivalent experience) is a plus.

THE OPPORTUNITY


Silvus is seeking an experienced, high-performing sales leader to serve as Senior Sales Director, Law Enforcement & Homeland Defense who will report directly to our Vice President of Sales, North America. This key leadership role establishes, builds, and leads a dedicated revenue pillar responsible for driving business growth across the US Department of War, National Guard, Federal Civilian & Law Enforcement agencies (DOJ, DHS, DOI, etc.), as well as State & Local Public Safety organizations.


This position leads a team of specialized Sales Directors, executing a bottom-up tactical sales strategy while aligning closely with top-of-funnel Market Development Executives (MDEs), Business Development Directors, and Spectrum Overlay specialists. This role requires up to 50% travel for customer site visits, tactical field demonstrations, executive briefings, and major industry trade shows.


This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location.

  • Business Ownership: Own and deliver the annual orders & revenue targets, quarterly quotas, and booking forecasts for the entire Law Enforcement & Homeland Defense vertical across North America.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Directly manage, mentor, and grow a team of specialized Sales Directors.
  • Pipeline Management & Data Analysis: Drive pipeline velocity, rigorous CRM tracking, and accurate forecasting for all deals within the vertical.
  • Cross Functional Alignment: Work closely with Silvus engineering, product development, marketing, and business development teams to grow the business.
  • Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.
  • Travel Requirement –Ability to travel up to 50% for customer site visits, tactical field demonstrations, executive briefings, and major industry trade shows.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Communications, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • 10+ years of successful sales leadership experience in tactical or public safety communications, C4ISR, electronic warfare, or defense/public safety technology.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of procurement processes, budget cycles, and operational frameworks across Federal Markets and / or State & Local markets.
  • Leadership Track Record: 2+ years of sales leadership experience building, scaling, and managing high-performing field sales teams with multi-million-dollar annual quotas.
  • Technical Aptitude: Strong grasp of RF communications, tactical MANET mesh networking, software-defined radios (SDR), and spectrum awareness solutions.
  • Security Clearance: Active U.S. Government SECRET clearance or the ability to obtain one within 15 months of hire.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizendue to clients under U.S. government contracts.
  • All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS.

  • Trade shows.
  • Outdoor environment for demonstrations.
  • Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following:

​ --Lift equipment up to 50 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing.

Profile Summary:

The Sr Analyst, Operational Risk Management (ORM) reports to the AVP of ORM and is responsible for supporting the Workplace Solutions/Benefitfocus ORM strategy and framework; ensuring a proper process is in place to mitigate risk. This role will assist the organization in the identification, classification, measurement, and monitoring of operational and related business risks. It will require working closely with others in ORM, Voya’s wider Risk Management function, and business units to provide business management with a consistent and accurate view of the sources, scale, and scope of identified risks. It will also require providing and presenting accurate data and conclusions, making actionable recommendations to Leadership, and holding Leadership accountable to timely and effective risk remediation.

ORM is defined as a continual cyclic process which includes risk assessment, consulting, decision making, and implementation of controls, which results in acceptance, mitigation, or avoidance of risk.ORM is the oversight of operational risk, and this role requires strong partnership in providing consulting and meaningful input to ensure risk data is captured, mitigation strategies and controls are developed, and appropriate reporting mechanisms are in place.


Please Note: This position allows remote work from home but will require travel to our Voya office as business requires.


Profile Description:


  • Member of the ORM team; support the development and execution of a robust ORM strategy, framework and policies.
  • This role will partner with the business to remediate identified risks in a timely manner and document progress and completion within Voya’s GRC tool.
  • Participate in the identification, assessment, measurement, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting of operational risk through the effective deployment of key operational risk management processes, including:
    • Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
    • Scenario analysis
    • Preparation/Presentation of Risk Committee slides/materials
    • Preparation of monthly/quarterly risk reports
    • Risk event management including post-incident reviews
    • Documenting issues within Voya’s GRC tool and ongoing monitoring of remediation efforts
    • Assist in analyzing data, creating, and presenting risk findings and recommendations to leadership
    • Targeted risk assessments
    • Project engagement and post-release assessments
    • Risk consulting/advice on new or updated process changes
    • Facilitate annual control attestation survey, analyze results, and report findings
  • Periodically engage in day-to-day activities performed by the business to better understand the procedures, controls, and identify risks.
  • Assist in promoting and instilling a strong risk culture and operational excellence by:
    • Creating risk awareness training materials and facilitating training sessions
    • Partnering with the business to continually improve operational risk processes and help strengthen business operating models
    • Promoting the use of effective controls within key business processes.
    • Embedding risk management understanding and culture into the business unit, informing risk related decision making.
  • Partner with other risk assurance functions, including internal audit, compliance, legal TPRM, corporate special investigation, privacy office, and IT ORM to develop a complete and aggregated view of risks.
  • Assist in providing an independent view which will consist of validating and endorsing business risk profiles and providing a constructive challenge to the business where residual risk levels are deemed to exceed standards.
  • Participate with ORM management in the development of risk management strategies for all business units: establishing business priorities and planning activities accordingly.
  • Collaborate with ORM team members and the Business, Technology, Innovation & Operations partners to identify opportunities to reduce manual processing through automation.
  • Interact with Sr. Leaders within the organization to provide risk advice/consulting on risk related issues to support the decision-making process.
  • Manage the development and administration of tools and procedures for reporting and daily operational risk processes. Such as SharePoint sites, Spreadsheets, Tableau, Presentations, GRC tool, Standard Work for ORM processes etc.
  • Remain up to date on current trends and external events to recognize and identify emerging risk within the business, assist in risk rating and identification of appropriate mitigation strategies.

  • Mindset of proactive communication and problem solving, with a continual focus on process improvement.
  • Ability to build relationships, trust, and a reputation for quality with Sr. Leaders.
  • Leveraging AI tools to support risk management activities is a plus.

ABOUT DEFCON AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. DEFCON AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, DEFCON AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

If your answer to “the two records disagree” is never overwrite, this role was built for you.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you’ll own the durable view of every resolved entity on the platform: the storage layer that holds what we know, where each fact came from, how confident we are in it, and how that picture has changed over time. When two sources disagree, both are kept with their evidence. When someone asks what we believed on a given date, and why, the platform can answer.

You’ll join the analytics and AI engineering team behind a system that ingests records from dozens of disparate sources, resolves them to the right entity, highlights what analysts should review first, and provides transparent, explainable recommendations that users can trust. Operating within a secure government cloud environment, the platform depends on a storage layer that never quietly erases a disagreement between sources.

Upstream matching is probabilistic. A match arrives with a confidence score rather than a yes, and the storage layer carries that uncertainty forward rather than collapsing it into one clean record. Sources change shape without warning and there is no shared key to join on, so this is a current data-engineering problem rather than a classic warehousing one.

The seniority this role calls for is about judgment, not tooling breadth: knowing why you never overwrite, and being able to reconstruct a past decision with its evidence a year later. If your instinct when records disagree is to preserve both and let a human decide, you’ll be at home here.

This is a fully remote role with occasional travel to DEFCON AI headquarters, customer sites, and partner facilities as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build the storage layer that preserves source disagreement and history rather than resolving them away at write time
  • Build the first release’s result and evidence store: saved per-person results linked to the originating record, prior results and human feedback retained separately, and configuration versions on every result
  • Implement provenance and lineage across every node and edge against the platform’s evidence-record contract
  • Store the versioned rule library and configuration, and record on every result the exact rule versions and ordered context supplied to any model-assisted step
  • Ensure every write is traceable to its origin and every decision is reproducible
  • Carry match confidence and other uncertainty forward through the platform rather than collapsing it into a single value
  • Support point-in-time questions: what did we believe about this entity on this date, and on what evidence
  • Define, with entity resolution and ML teammates, what the storage layer needs to receive and what it must serve downstream

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years in data engineering or data platform engineering, including production experience with versioned, temporal, or historized data models
  • Experience designing storage where history, provenance, and source disagreement are first-class rather than resolved away
  • Comfort building on probabilistic upstream output rather than a clean shared key
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production experience on PostgreSQL or comparable
  • US Citizenship Required
  • Active US Secret clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building the storage layer downstream of an entity-resolution or record-linkage system
  • Bi-temporal, event-sourced, graph, or temporal data modeling in production
  • Federal, government, or regulated-industry experience where a historical decision had to be reproducible on demand
  • Active Top Secret clearance

What Success Looks Like

  • A durable view that never silently overwrites a disagreement between sources
  • “What did we believe on this date, and on what evidence” is answerable a year later
  • The storage layer holds up as probabilistic match output flows in, rather than assuming a clean join

What We Offer

  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval
  • Flexible work environment where you manage your work day
  • 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave
